% build.sh driver fixture: study guide. One worked example (strategy \step
% first, then the computation, then the boxed result) paired with the try-it
% that re-parameterizes it, so the fixture passes answer-key-ss (positional
% binding + pairing + role agreement), ss-structure (check_study_guide), and
% prose-ss. Environments are stubbed inline so the fixture also compiles
% under a real engine.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath, graphicx}
\newenvironment{examplebox}{}{}
\newenvironment{tryitbox}{}{}
\newcounter{exstep}
\newcommand{\step}[1]{\par\noindent\textbf{Step \stepcounter{exstep}\theexstep.}~#1}
\newcommand{\ans}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\begin{document}
\section*{Build-demo study guide}
\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} In a right triangle, the angle is $30^\circ$ and the
adjacent side is $8$. Find the opposite side $a$.
\step{Want the side opposite the angle, know the adjacent --- that is TOA:
$\tan A = \text{opp}/\text{adj}$.}
\step{$a = 8\tan 30^\circ = 4.6188\ldots$}
$a \approx \boxed{4.62}$
\end{examplebox}
\begin{tryitbox}
\textbf{Try it:} Solve $x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0$.\\
\rotatebox{180}{\footnotesize check: $\ans{x = 2 \text{ or } x = 5}$}
\end{tryitbox}
\end{document}
